uplink.description: Status report, both probes dry (report type 0x01)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds input (deviceType 0x46 = 70 = R718WA2). Expected.data from running reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt 3.6, WaterLeak_1 NoLeak, WaterLeak_2 NoLeak); each probe is its own channels[] entry carrying water.leak.

uplink.description: Probes differ: probe0 wet, probe1 dry (per-position truth)
uplink._note: TTN example "Status report" byte pattern (byte4 = 1, byte5 = 0). Expected.data from running reference/upstream-codec.js (WaterLeak_1 Leak, WaterLeak_2 NoLeak): bytes[4] -> probe0 leak true, bytes[5] -> probe1 leak false.

uplink.description: Probes differ the other way: probe0 dry, probe1 wet (the case the retired any-probe OR could not express)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds input (byte5 = 1). Expected.data from running reference/upstream-codec.js (WaterLeak_1 NoLeak, WaterLeak_2 Leak). Pins entry order to the wire order and exercises per-position truth: the old top-level water.leak OR read `true` here with no way to say which probe was wet.

uplink.description: Status report, both probes wet (report type 0x01)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds input (byte4 = byte5 = 1). Expected.data from running reference/upstream-codec.js (WaterLeak_1 Leak, WaterLeak_2 Leak).

uplink.description: Low-battery flag set (high bit of voltage byte) surfaces lowBattery extra
uplink._note: Synthetic input: byte3 = 0x80 | 36 = 164. Upstream emits Volt '3.6(low battery)'; normalized to top-level battery 3.6 + lowBattery true (whole-device readings, never inside an entry).

uplink.description: Device-info / startup frame carries no measurement (report type 0x00)
uplink._note: TTN example input (report type 0x00). Upstream returns device/version/datecode metadata; we report no measurement.

uplink.description: Config response on fPort 7 is unsupported
uplink._note: TTN example input (ConfigReportRsp on fPort 7). Config frames carry no measurement; we report unsupported fPort.
